info.title: TeachEase Backend
info.description: Teacher-controlled assessment review. OCR and Gemini generation are ONLINE only. Phone offline work requires no backend login. All /v1 routes require Supabase access tokens; production requires aal2.

delete.description: Archives an assessment, retaining keys and historical results. Repeat calls are idempotent.

post.description: Creates a new immutable draft version, including updated question competency tags. Never changes earlier results.
Atomically creates and teacher-verifies a locally reviewed key. Identical retry returns already_uploaded; different data with the same UUID returns 409.
Online-only Gemini extraction. Image is decoded and metadata stripped, then discarded after extraction. No key, submission or image is automatically saved.

patch.description: Rename only. Structural links and date ranges remain immutable to preserve history.

post.description:
Validate CSV/XLSX and preview grade/section assignments. Does not save records.

Select an existing academic year and enrollment start date. Required columns:
student_number, student_email, student_name, grade_level; optional section.
Row errors return 200 with valid=false. File-level errors use the standard error envelope.

Save all students and enrollments atomically after teacher confirmation.

Re-send the previewed file/options and its fingerprint, plus a stable client import UUID.
Identical retries return already_imported. Changed data with a reused UUID returns 409.
Conflicting rows save nothing; preview again for detailed row errors.

get.description: Retrieve the original teacher-scoped import receipt, including assigned server UUIDs.
